name: Thompson-Boling Arena at Food City Center

bagPolicy.summary: Food City Center allows one clear plastic bag no larger than 12 x 6 x 12 inches or one one-gallon clear resealable bag per person, plus a small clutch no larger than 4.5 x 6.5 inches. All items are subject to search, and no other bags are allowed.
allowed: Clear plastic bag no larger than 12 x 6 x 12 inches
One-gallon clear resealable plastic storage bag
Small clutch no larger than 4.5 x 6.5 inches
bagPolicy.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

parking.summary: Concert and special-event parking is $20, card only, with no cash accepted. Parking is available in adjacent lots and garages, and the venue publishes garage clearances ranging from 6 feet 6 inches to 8 feet 6 inches.
parking.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

rideshare.summary: The reviewed official Food City Center venue guidance does not state a specific rideshare pickup or drop-off policy.
rideshare.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

concessions.summary: Food City Center has permanent concession stands plus portable locations at selected events. The venue lists items including pizza, pretzels, hot dogs, hamburgers, chicken strips, lemonade, ice cream, nachos, popcorn, candy, Moe's, Great American Cookie, Calhoun's BBQ, Coca-Cola products, and Dasani water.
concessions.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

accessibility.summary: Accessible seating and restrooms are available throughout the arena, and accessible parking is offered in surrounding lots on a first-come, first-served basis. Assistive listening devices are available with photo ID as collateral, and sign-language interpreters may be requested at least two weeks before an event.
accessibility.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

reEntry.summary: Thompson-Boling Arena at Food City Center has a no re-entry policy and does not issue passes out.
reEntry.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

ticketPickup.summary: The venue identifies ticket facilities on the Phillip Fulmer Way level and publishes separate phone contacts for concerts and athletics, but the reviewed page does not state one universal will-call or ticket-pickup procedure.
ticketPickup.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

gates.summary: Main entrance gates are at the top of the concrete pedestrian ramps on the east and west sides of the building. Door times for concerts and special events vary by event and are published with the event listing.
